title: Ukrainian Egg Frittata
description: A peppery and silky Ukrainian dish featuring amaretti and ferment-jang, perfect for a brunch mood, cooked in a kazan cauldron. This halal-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional frittatas.
instructions: Preheat the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the crushed amaretti cookies, ferment-jang, and grated cheddar cheese to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Melt the butter in the preheated kazan cauldron.
Pour the egg mixture into the kazan cauldron and cook for 5 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the frittata towards the center.
Continue cooking for an additional 10 minutes or until the eggs are almost set.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley on top of the frittata and cook for a final 2 minutes.
Remove the kazan cauldron from the heat and let the frittata cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
